headline: Japan's economic-policy council sets out proposals on AI, work and national capability
summary: Japan's Economic and Fiscal Policy Council held its fifteenth meeting on 29 October 2026 with AI-driven economic and social change as a formal agenda item. Advisory members submitted proposals on broader public and business AI use, labor-market transition, AI-agent responsibility, AI-related productivity and token-cost measurement, cybersecurity, domestic capability and education. A government paper described ongoing work toward a 2030 vision, cross-government reform principles and possible legal and safety-control updates, with a year-end interim summary planned. These are submitted proposals and stated work directions; the meeting record does not establish adopted law, budget allocations, implementation or measured outcomes.
